component.name: Keephaven Guard Dog
component.summary: Find where you show up online and get removed

description.p: Finds where you show up online, helps you get removed, and keeps watching. It runs on your own computer.

ul.li: Searches 17 people-search sites for each name and place, and breach lists for each email.
Scans again every 6 hours by default (Settings, 1 to 720 hours, or 0 for only when you press Scan) and tells you about new listings, listings that come back, and new breaches.
